LanguageData.PF_BarrenRock.label: barren rock plains
LanguageData.PF_BarrenRock.description: Exposed rock and rubble without vegetation, suitable for many barren rocky bodies.
LanguageData.PF_BarrenRock.settleWarning: There is no breathable atmosphere here. Prepare a sealed habitat, EVA equipment and thermal protection before landing.
LanguageData.PF_BarrenRegolith.label: barren regolith plains
LanguageData.PF_BarrenRegolith.description: Dry ground covered by fine regolith, with no natural plants or animals.
LanguageData.PF_BarrenRegolith.settleWarning: There is no breathable atmosphere here. Prepare a sealed habitat, EVA equipment and thermal protection before landing.
LanguageData.PF_FrozenPlain.label: frozen plains
LanguageData.PF_FrozenPlain.description: A persistently cold icy surface that can combine with rocky outcrops on frozen bodies.
LanguageData.PF_FrozenPlain.settleWarning: There is no breathable atmosphere here. Prepare a sealed habitat, EVA equipment and thermal protection before landing.
LanguageData.PF_GreenhousePlain.label: scorching plains
LanguageData.PF_GreenhousePlain.description: A scorching, dry surface beneath a dense atmosphere, without natural ecology. Pressure and gas toxicity require additional environment capabilities.
LanguageData.PF_GreenhousePlain.settleWarning: Surface temperatures are extreme. Ordinary colonists and equipment cannot safely remain exposed outdoors.
